```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(BayesFactor)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

In the following, we present exploratory, non-preregistered analyses of intergroup bias. Intergroup bias is the outcome variable in all analyses, and we assume that, typically, participants should prefer their ingroup over the outgroup. Here, we test whether the intergroup bias is present in all studies.

## Read in data

```{r}
nhb1a <- read.csv('../../data/nhb1a_processed.csv')
nhb1b <- read.csv('../../data/nhb1b_processed.csv')
nhb2 <- read.csv('../../data/nhb2_processed.csv')
nhb3 <- read.csv('../../data/nhb3_processed.csv')
```

## Write functions

```{r}

# Analyze ingroup-outgroup effects for Tajfel points
analyze_inout_points <- function(data, title){
  
  inout <- melt(data, 
              id.vars = "X", 
              measure.vars = c("total_ingroup_points", "total_outgroup_points"),
              variable.name = "Group", value.name = "Points")
  
  inout$Group <- recode_values(inout$Group,
              "total_ingroup_points" ~ "Ingroup",
              "total_outgroup_points" ~ "Outgroup")
  
  p <- ggplot(inout, mapping = aes(x = Group, y = Points)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = title)
  
  freqtest <- t.test(data$total_ingroup_minus_outgroup_points, alternative = "greater")
  bayestest <- ttestBF(data$total_ingroup_minus_outgroup_points, nullInterval = c(0, Inf))
  
  return(list(p=p, freqtest=freqtest, bayestest=bayestest))
}

# Analyze ingroup-outgroup effects for positive traits
analyze_inout_traits <- function(data, title){
  
  inout <- melt(data, 
              id.vars = "X", 
              measure.vars = c("mean_ingroup_traits_positive", "mean_outgroup_traits_positive"),
              variable.name = "Group", value.name = "Traits")
  
  inout$Group <- recode_values(inout$Group,
              "mean_ingroup_traits_positive" ~ "Ingroup",
              "mean_outgroup_traits_positive" ~ "Outgroup")
  
  p <- ggplot(inout, mapping = aes(x = Group, y = Traits)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = title)
  
  freqtest <- t.test(data$ingroup_minus_outgroup_traits_positive, alternative = "greater")
  bayestest <- ttestBF(na.omit(data$ingroup_minus_outgroup_traits_positive), nullInterval = c(0, Inf))
  
  return(list(p=p, freqtest=freqtest, bayestest=bayestest))
}

# Analyze ingroup-outgroup effects for identification

analyze_inout_ident <- function(data, title){
  
  inout <- melt(data, 
              id.vars = "X", 
              measure.vars = c("IngroupIdentify", "OutgroupIdentify"),
              variable.name = "Group", value.name = "Identification")
  
  inout$Group <- recode_values(inout$Group,
              "IngroupIdentify" ~ "Ingroup",
              "OutgroupIdentify" ~ "Outgroup")
  
  p <- ggplot(inout, mapping = aes(x = Group, y = Identification)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = title)
  
  freqtest <- t.test(data$ingroup_minus_outgroup_identify, alternative = "greater")
  bayestest <- ttestBF(na.omit(data$ingroup_minus_outgroup_identify), nullInterval = c(0, Inf))
  
  return(list(p=p, freqtest=freqtest, bayestest=bayestest))
}

```


## Ingroup and Outgroup Points

```{r}
# Calculate results
inout_NHB1a <- analyze_inout_points(nhb1a, "Study 1: Prolific")
inout_NHB1b <- analyze_inout_points(nhb1b, "Study 1: MTurk")
inout_NHB2 <- analyze_inout_points(nhb2, "Study 2")
inout_NHB3 <- analyze_inout_points(nhb3, "Study 3")

# Plot
(inout_NHB1a$p + inout_NHB1b$p)/(inout_NHB2$p + inout_NHB3$p)

# Hypothesis testing results
testres <- matrix(c(inout_NHB1a$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB1a$bayestest)$bf[1],
                    inout_NHB1b$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB1b$bayestest)$bf[1],
                    inout_NHB2$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB2$bayestest)$bf[1],
                    inout_NHB3$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB3$bayestest)$bf[1]),
                  nrow = 4, ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
rownames(testres) <- c("Study 1 (Prolific)", "Study 1 (MTurk)", "Study 3", "Study 4")

kable(testres, 
      row.names = TRUE,
      col.names = c("p-value", "Bayes factor"),
      digits = 3) %>% kable_styling(position = "left")
```

## Ingroup and Outgroup Traits

```{r}
# Calculate results
inout_NHB1a <- analyze_inout_traits(nhb1a, "Study 1: Prolific")
inout_NHB1b <- analyze_inout_traits(nhb1b, "Study 1: MTurk")
inout_NHB2 <- analyze_inout_traits(nhb2, "Study 2")
inout_NHB3 <- analyze_inout_traits(nhb3, "Study 3")

# Plot
suppressWarnings((inout_NHB1a$p + inout_NHB1b$p)/(inout_NHB2$p + inout_NHB3$p))

# Hypothesis testing results
testres <- matrix(c(inout_NHB1a$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB1a$bayestest)$bf[1],
                    inout_NHB1b$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB1b$bayestest)$bf[1],
                    inout_NHB2$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB2$bayestest)$bf[1],
                    inout_NHB3$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB3$bayestest)$bf[1]),
                  nrow = 4, ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
rownames(testres) <- c("Study 1 (Prolific)", "Study 1 (MTurk)", "Study 3", "Study 4")

kable(testres, 
      row.names = TRUE,
      col.names = c("p-value", "Bayes factor"),
      digits = 3) %>% kable_styling(position = "left")
```

(inout_NHB1a$p + inout_NHB1b$p)/(inout_NHB2$p + inout_NHB3$p)

                    inout_NHB1b$freqtest$p.value, extractBF(inout_NHB1b$bayestest)$bf[1],
